If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is <0.33 in the last 3 days and forecast is falling, increase late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment spikes to 1.00 in the 3rd-to-5th day of forecast horizon, shift mid-period forecast upward by 0.8–1.2% to reflect bullish momentum.  
If sentiment drops to 0.00 in the 3rd-to-5th day of forecast horizon, shift mid-period forecast downward by 0.8–1.2% to reflect bearish momentum.  
If forecast shows a steep upward slope in early horizon and sentiment is mixed (0.33–0.67), flatten early forecast to avoid over-leveraging bullish bias.  
If forecast shows a steep downward slope in early horizon and sentiment is mixed (0.33–0.67), flatten early forecast to avoid over-leveraging bearish bias.
